original_ai_output.title_zh: 欧盟与德国资助的南苏丹性暴力防治项目四年期满结束
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 由欧盟和德国联邦经济合作与发展部共同资助、德国国际合作机构实施的“ResPEct：停止性暴力”项目在南苏丹结束四年执行期。项目为超过12300名性暴力和性别暴力幸存者提供医疗与心理社会支持，惠及逾38000人，覆盖朱巴、耶伊河和阿韦勒西等县。项目在朱巴举行闭幕活动，各方呼吁持续推动性别平等与预防暴力。

key_facts.fact: 欧盟与德国资助的南苏丹性暴力防治项目在实施四年后结束
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: EU, Germany-funded SGBV prevention project reaches end after four years

key_facts.fact: 项目为超过12300名性暴力和性别暴力幸存者提供医疗与心理社会支持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the project provided medical care and psychosocial support to more than 12,300 survivors and people affected by SGBV

key_facts.fact: 项目惠及超过38000人，覆盖朱巴、耶伊河和阿韦勒西等县
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: benefited more than 38,000 people... targeted internally displaced people, returnees and host communities in Aweil West, Juba and Yei River counties

key_facts.fact: 德国自2022年以来为该项目投入超过600万美元
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Germany had invested more than $6 million in the GIZ project since 2022

key_facts.fact: 项目在朱巴举行闭幕活动，政府官员、捐助方和妇女团体等参加
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The project marked the end of its implementation with a closing event in Juba, bringing together government officials, donors, women’s groups and other partners

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
